svg.title: Runtime workload protocol
svg.desc: A paired result is valid only when every task and warmup succeeds and both cells have active memory samples. Report distributions and repeat spread, not an isolated fastest cell. The 2× gate compares task throughput with both arms below the same explicit RAM budget (default 2 GiB); descriptive throughput/GiB ratios alone do not prove that gate. The 30% active footprint gate compares matched concurrency and workload using sampled whole-family peak. Sampling is too coarse to claim an exact instantaneous peak. Overall acceptance requires the complete matrix, no success regression and no per-task-type p95 regression above 10%, not any one passing row. A pair with any cell error or resource abort is ineligible even if its measured tasks happened to finish first. These are performance gates, not evidence of general agent reliability.
